about: F4 (plan 7.5) baseline for this repo's scripts/check_failure_contract.py: rule 3 (one founder state per code; every ask rendered in both journeys; render_gaps lists the reviewed exceptions), rule 5 (operator_only_codes are never a founder ask in either view), rule 6 (stop codes) and rule 7 (sweeps: every scheduled sweep and global alert rule; a new one names a shadow_flag and a history_horizon the deploy config validator installs). Ratchets may only fall (CI passes --ratchet-base). Content Factory's checker owns rules 1, 2 and 4.

render_gaps.reason: Legacy Articles status (website_status OWNER_ACTIONS) has no buy_points action, so a legacy founder short of points sees View details; the points card elsewhere is the only prompt. Plan D15 moves legacy orgs onto the server-owned journey.

B23: the ask travels without an action id for old desktop builds and founder_journey FOUNDER_ASKS has no add_seed_topics; only the P2 card (ask_add_seed_topics) renders it, so the P1 path shows the fallback card.
